articles.title: John Healey pledges to use budget to harness power of AI to bolster Britain’s security
articles.excerpt: Chancellor says government to commit hundreds of millions to develop ‘distinctively British’ approach to AI John Healey has pledged to use Wednesday’s budget to harness the power of artificial intelligence to bolster Britain’s security and prosperity against the risks in the accelerating global technology arms race.
